description: Destroy tool. The preview case is what proves the synthesized state fetch: the tool declares no fetch_state hook, so both languages read the lock through linode_lock_get, the sibling declared on the same route, and report it as that read's own message.

cases.name: rejects a non-positive lock_id
cases.expect_error: lock_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: refuses a fractional lock_id rather than truncating it
cases.expect_error: lock_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: confirm alone hits the destroy gate
cases.expect_error:
linode_lock_delete is destructive. Either:
  1. Call with dry_run: true first to preview, then call again with
     confirm: true, confirmed_dry_run: true
  2. Call with confirm: true, confirm_bypass_dry_run: true to skip preview
  3. Use yolo: true (only if profile allows)
